items.title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?

articles.title: From 1D Benchmarks to Complex 3D Geometries: Can Agents Reliably Specify Problems for Automated PDE Simulation?
articles.summary: Turning an engineering request into a simulation requires consistent geometry, physics, boundary conditions, and numerical settings. Recent agent-assisted systems automate simulation setup, but successful execution alone does not establish whether the specification preserves the intended problem or correctly handles missing information. We study whether agents can reliably construct complete executable JSON specifications for automated geometry creation, meshing, PDE solving, and result export. Our workflow combines model extraction with deterministic scientific and capability checks, explicit clarification, and validated local patches that preserve unrelated accepted fields. We evaluate specification correctness, execution completion, and numerical verification separately. On 120 template-related requests, the full workflow achieves 98.3% correct first-turn specification and decision outcomes, compared with 92.5% for schema-assisted single shot and 82.5% for model-only: gains of 5.8 and 15.8 percentage points, respectively. It makes no false-ready decisions among the 42 requests requiring clarification or rejection. Component ablations identify contributions from scientific checks…

articles.summary: Gemini 3.7 Flash deprecation : gemini-3.7-flash is deprecated and has been replaced by gemini-3.8-flash . It is no longer available to select in Google AI Studio, and API requests to gemini-3.7-flash are automatically routed to gemini-3.8-flash . Update your model string to gemini-3.8-flash and review the Gemini 3.8 Flash guide . Gemini 3.5 Flash deprecation : gemini-3.5-flash is deprecated and has been replaced by gemini-3.6-flash . It is no longer available to select in Google AI Studio, and API requests to gemini-3.5-flash are automatically routed to gemini-3.6-flash . Update your model string to gemini-3.6-flash (or gemini-3.8-flash ) and review the Gemini 3.6 Flash guide . Deep Research Agent deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025 deprecation : The deep-research-pro-preview-12-2025 agent is deprecated and will be shut down on October 23, 2026 .
